findings.title: Emergency alert module bypasses model router via direct LLM API calls

evidence.observation: Direct invocations of call_gemini and call_mistral with environment API keys instead of routing through the model router

proposed_action.description: Migrate direct Gemini and Mistral calls in emergency alert generation to request completions via the centralized model router

findings.expected_benefit: Centralized latency monitoring, quota control, failure tracking, and model switching without code changes

findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: Model router indicates call_log_exists is false for configured path /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl

proposed_action.description: Ensure the directory for call_log.jsonl exists with proper write permissions and router initializes the log stream on startup

findings.expected_benefit: Restores auditability and latency metrics tracking for model routing operations

findings.title: Model router has recorded multiple recent invocation failures

evidence.observation: Router status reports recent_failed count of 5 and null recent_avg_ms

proposed_action.description: Inspect model router stderr and Ollama service connectivity to identify the root cause of recent failed calls

findings.expected_benefit: Prevents downstream service failures and degraded agent execution across the platform

findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 authorization and memory integration in research commands

evidence.observation: TODO comments indicating unimplemented Phase 5 authorization checking via Supabase and decision_to_memory integration

proposed_action.description: Implement Phase 5 Supabase authorization checks and memory dispatching in research command handler

findings.expected_benefit: Enforces access control and persists research command outcomes to memory

findings.title: Quality anomaly query stubbed with empty list in quality forecasting

evidence.observation: Hardcoded empty list with comment 'TODO: Query quality_anomalies table'

proposed_action.description: Implement database query to fetch anomalies from quality_anomalies table in quality forecasting module

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures quality forecasts incorporate historical quality anomalies rather than assuming zero anomalies
